inference.HAC: OLS score sandwich Bartlett lag12; n/(n-k) finite-sample correction; asymptotic normal two-sided p
inference.favorable_group_mean_hac: Regress active*I on I with no intercept on the uncompressed original monthly timeline, and n/(n-1) correction; avoids treating separated group months as adjacent
inference.Holm: 8 hypotheses per sample: four condition contrasts, four expected favorable-state mean-versus-zero tests
inference.bootstrap: Joint label-outcome circular 6/12-month blocks, 20000 draws, seed20261004; retained draws require both groups
inference.annualization: Monthly arithmetic means/differences multiplied by12; not strategy CAGR
inference.positive_group: H1 complement, H2/H3/H4 true; fixed before conditional results
